responsibility: Implements GVN-based full redundancy elimination, partial redundancy elimination, and code hoisting on GIMPLE SSA. Built on top of SCC/RPO value numbering, it computes availability and anticipatability sets, performs insertion of expressions and PHIs to make partially redundant computations fully redundant, eliminates now-redundant expressions, runs cleanup DCE and tail merging, and manages the PRE-specific expression/bitmap infrastructure that complements but is distinct from the core VN engine.
